**Because life is better with pets.**



We deliver the **Ultimate Care Experience — every pet, every client, every time.** That starts with a Culture of Care that supports our team members as much as the pets and clients we serve.



With more than **420 locally led hospitals** and over **11,000 team members nationwide**, we offer:


* Local autonomy with national support
* Career mobility and development opportunities
* A collaborative, inclusive environment where your wellbeing comes first


**You care for pets. We care for you.**

Join our team as a **Care Coordinator** who contributes to the success of a high\-performing organization committed to delivering superior care and exceptional service. Performs a range of administrative and customer service tasks, providing valuable support to the hospital. Within the veterinary field, this position aligns closely with roles often titled Veterinary Receptionist, Customer Service Representative, or Client Care Specialist.

**Grass Valley Veterinary Hospital** in Grass Valley, CA is a warm, small\-animal general practice where compassionate care and teamwork come first. Our close\-knit team supports one another and our clients every step of the way, creating a positive and collaborative environment. We're looking for a dedicated professional to join our lovely team and grow with us as we provide exceptional care to the pets and people of our community.

* Provides excellent customer service in\-person, over the phone, and during high\-stress situations.

* Assists with medication pickups, inquiries, and provides information about services and products.
* Inputs and manages data in practice management software, including billing and accounts.

**Schedule:** Part\-time with varying shifts based on hospital needs; 2–8 hour shifts. Candidates must be flexible with scheduling


At PetVet Care Centers, we're committed to a **Culture of Care** — for pets, for the people who love them, and for the team members who make it all possible. **You care for pets. We care for you.**

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator (Temporary)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Patient Care Coordinator to support daily clinic operations on our team at Halo Skin Institute! The Patient Care Coordinator supports daily clinic operations at Halo Skin Institute by maintaining exceptional organization, clear communication, and high administrative accuracy. Reporting directly to the Office Manager, this position serves as the primary point of contact for front desk workflows, operational tasks, and patient check\-ins. This role requires a strong commitment to providing excellent customer service to all patients while adhering to strict healthcare compliance, patient confidentiality rules, and clinical protocols.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Greet and check in patients to foster an exceptional patient experience.

· Monitor daily schedules to ensure smooth clinic flow.

· Keep the front desk, lobby, and restroom facilities clean, organized, and presentable throughout the day.

· Answer incoming phone calls from patients, returning voicemails, and follow up efficiently on patient inquiries.

· Rescheduling all cancelled or no show patients, and rescheduling per patient’s requests.

· Proactively following up on new referrals, schedule referrals, and future follow up calls.

· Recording interaction and phone calls accurately within the electronic system.

· Contacting new referrals, and managing digital referral queues daily.

· Sending referral status letters to referring providers.

· Proactively monitor and manage task boxes (New Referrals, Scheduled Referrals, No Follow\-Up Scheduled, Cancelled / No Reschedule, and Future Follow\-Up Calls), and scheduling follow ups as needed.

· Attempting to reschedule all canceled or no\-show patients, track attempts, and escalate per clinic guidelines.

· Monitor, process, and clear the incoming e\-fax inbox following clinic guidelines.

· Correctly label, categorize, and assign tasks for all securely uploaded scans and e\-faxes —including pathology reports, lab reports, insurance authorizations, prior authorization requests, medication requests, and records requests.

· Review and prepare patient charts thoroughly for all upcoming appointments by keeping files organized attaching required reports.

**Experience**

· High School Diploma required, Bachelor’s degree preferred

· Previous experience in an office setting in the medical industry preferred

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

· Experience in providing customer service.

· Ability to maintain a professional, friendly, and team\-oriented demeanor with patients.

· Ability to execute high\-volume scheduling, referral tracking, and document uploading with zero errors and strict adherence to clinic guidelines.

· Thorough knowledge of HIPAA guidelines and California privacy laws to maintain absolute patient confidentiality both during and after employment.

· Understanding of clinical operational boundaries, ensuring that medical questions are directed to providers and no medical advice is distributed.

· Skill in tracking multiple task categories, prioritizing complex referrals, and adhering to provider availability caps and Accutane timelines.

· Ability to operate and navigate practice technology, electronic devices, software, and communication tools responsibly and solely for business\-related purposes.

· Ability to accurately file, label, and organize electronic records, with the understanding that e\-faxed documents are proprietary and must never be deleted.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to remain in a stationary position (sitting or standing) at the front desk area for prolonged periods to greet visitors, answer phone lines, and perform administrative data entry.
* Physical capacity to regularly move about the office space to clear the e\-fax machine, prepare and organize medical charts, monitor patient flow, and cross\-coordinate with clinical staff.
* Continual operation of office computers, software programs, scanning devices, and phone systems, requiring manual dexterity to file documents properly and input precise textual data without deleting record components.
* Visual and auditory capacity to effectively listen, speak, and exchange highly accurate information with patients, family members, providers, and office supervisors during phone calls and face\-to\-face interactions.
* Ability to perform physical tasks required to clean, wipe down, organize, and maintain the daily professional appearance of the front desk workspace, patient waiting lobby, and shared restroom facilities.
* Ability to occasionally lift, position, or move office materials, charts, or cleanup supplies weighing up to 20 pounds.

**Additional Details**

Ever Well Health is searching for a caring and compassionate Behavioral Health Program Manager to join our growing team.

*We've made a commitment to provide superior care through thoughtful and empathetic treatment, for adults experiencing significant mental or emotional issues.*

The Behavioral Health Program Manager will be a major contributor to our core mission. This role will be a direct line of support, creating a safe, secure and nurturing environment for our residents.

**If you meet the requirements below, please apply.** **Your contribution will truly make a difference.**

**REPORTS TO:** Director of Behavioral Health

**SALARY:** $68,000\-$85,000

**JOB SUMMARY**

Under administrative direction, the Behavioral Health Program Manager (BHPM) provides leadership, coordination, and supervision for all aspects of specialized programs and services in assigned Enclaves to ensure high\-quality and reliable care. Utilizing established systems this role manages therapeutic, behavioral and recovery care services and staff; ensures safety of staff and residents; and supports implementation of policies, procedures, and protocols. Requiring independent judgment in the organization, supervision, and evaluation of individual and group services, the Behavioral Health Program Manager assigns and monitors specific staff duties and performance. The BHPM communicates Ever Well’s mission and models the expectations for staff to resident, staff to staff, and resident to resident relationships. The role is expected to promote a therapeutic healing enclave atmosphere, where residents and staff are treated with understanding, patience, and dignity always. * Ensure residents participate in planned activities and services according to their interests and abilities. Responsible for the planning, organization, supervision, and evaluation of resident participation and satisfaction. \*
* Monitor planned activity and service delivery success according to stated key performance indicators (KPIs) using established data collection systems. Report metrics weekly at regional Enclave management meetings. Report metrics timely to director level to support program enhancement and organizational goals to ensure responsive care consistent with emerging resident needs. \*
* Assist in the recruitment and hiring of employees; assures provision of initial orientation, onboarding, and ongoing staff career growth; conducts performance evaluation and disciplinary actions in conjunction with Employee Care \& Wellness as required; and assists in the coordination of staff consistent with program needs. Maintains confidential personnel records. \*

* Work in collaboration with other service line managers to ensure all staff follow company policies and procedures and always remain in compliance with CCL regulation and standards. \*
* Manage Behavioral Health Program Coordinators (BHPC), provide weekly consultation and coordination of individualized behavioral health supports across the Enclave to facilitate resident progress and recovery. This includes oversight of the Targeted Behavioral Agreement Contract processes, supports and reinforcers. Partner with the Residential Service Line managers to expedite the Treatment Relapse Prevention Plan processes, notifications, and collaboration with key stakeholders.
* Manage the Therapeutic Activities Program Coordinators (TAPC), provide weekly consultation and coordination of activities, groups, classes, holidays, events, specials, and outings. This includes implementation and evaluation of program components, resident participation and programmatic fit of group interventions planned across the Enclave and reported via established KPIs.
* Seek consultation as needed related to substantive program approaches and clinical information. Monitor and provide feedback on the utilization of service line discretionary and budgeted resources for therapeutic, recovery and behavioral services to meet resident needs. The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long\-term solutions.

Permanent housing is not simply a destination — it is the foundation from which recovery, stability, and forward momentum become possible. For participants living in interim housing, the path to that foundation requires skilled guidance, consistent support, and someone committed to making it happen. The Housing\-Focused Case Manager is that person.


Working under the supervision of the Program Manager, the Housing\-Focused Case Manager provides individualized, housing\-first case management to participants in Hope the Mission's interim housing programs. This role prioritizes rapid placement into permanent housing using low\-barrier, harm\-reduction, and trauma\-informed approaches — and is directly accountable for the documentation, engagement, and cross\-team collaboration that makes those placements possible. The goal is not just to find someone a home. It is to shorten their time in shelter, strengthen their readiness, and build the stability that allows them to stay housed once they get there.

* Provide individualized, housing\-focused case management using Housing First, low\-barrier, and trauma\-informed approaches with a primary emphasis on rapid permanent housing placement.

* Develop, implement, and regularly update Housing Action Plans with clear, measurable goals oriented toward permanent housing placement
* Maintain active, regular contact with participants focused on housing progress, problem\-solving, and motivation

*Collaboration \& Coordination*

Environmental Traveling Companions (ETC) is a volunteer\-based nonprofit providing the joy and challenge of outdoor adventures to people with all abilities and from all backgrounds since 1972\. We inspire self\-confidence, connection to nature, and community\-based environmental stewardship through accessible sea kayaking, rafting, and multi\-week expeditions for youth from historically marginalized backgrounds.

The Youth LEAD (Leadership, Environment, Adventure, and Diversity) Program (YLP) is one of ETC’s three main programs. We provide life\-changing outdoor experiences for youth (14–18\-year\-olds) from marginalized cultural and economic backgrounds, focusing on technical outdoor skills, environmental education, socio\-emotional growth, and leadership development. Our 14\-to\-21\-day courses incorporate sea kayaking, rafting, and backpacking. Students learn about themselves, their community of peers, natural history, and environmental science through lessons, storytelling, community\-building, and adventure in the wilderness. Graduates of a YLP Summer course are eligible to apply for the school year Fellowship program.

The Fellowship aims to support students in continuing to build their leadership skills and connection to the outdoors through monthly overnight excursions, bi\-weekly virtual sessions, and training as Sea Kayak Assistant Guides. The monthly in\-person activities take place in the beautiful parks, preserves, and open waters of the greater Bay Area. In addition to leadership skill development, YLP Fellows study the region’s marine and coastal ecosystems, the effects of climate change, and Indigenous history of the Bay Area, all while building lasting interpersonal connections with one another and the larger ETC community. After they graduate, Fellows can apply to be a Fellow Field Intern on a YLP Summer Course, acting as a member of the leadership team. The Fellowship program aims to provide opportunities for youth to build the skills needed to become thoughtful community members, budding outdoor guides, and lifelong environmental stewards.

**Position Overview**

The Youth LEAD Program Coordinator’s main focus is the school year Fellowship Program: Building curriculum and facilitating virtual sessions, planning and facilitating monthly overnight outdoor excursions/site visits, with support from the Youth LEAD Program Manager as outlined below.

ETC staff have a hybrid schedule working in\-person at the office at Fort Mason Center in San Francisco on Tuesdays and Thursdays, with the option to work from home the rest of the week. During the summer, there is a higher need for more in office work for the Youth LEAD team. Some weekend work is required for Fellowship overnight trips once per month from September through May, YLP trips and some weekend days during the summer. The schedule varies according to YLP summer course prep, start and graduation dates. Amazing opportunity to connect with youth, help develop their outdoor leadership skills and build community.

**Key Responsibilities**

In the Fall, Winter, and Spring, the Program Coordinator will take a lead role in the

coordination and facilitation of the Youth LEAD Fellowship Program that runs from

September through May, with support from the Program Manager and ETC Staff.

○ Screen applicants and conduct interviews for potential Youth LEAD Fellows with

support from the Program Manager. Select candidates, send acceptances and

communicate regularly with Fellows

○ Provide positive support for the Youth LEAD Fellows, a group of up to 10 high

schoolers who are growing as leaders in the outdoors

○ Plan and lead bi\-weekly virtual evening sessions with Fellows. Topics include:

environmental education, personal development, leadership skills, human history,

wilderness readiness, environmental stewardship, and more.

○ Plan and lead monthly weekend Fellowship overnight events (i.e: camping,

educational farm visits, sea kayaking, rock climbing, ...) with support from the

Program Manager

events (i.e. Slide Ranch, Outward Bound Ropes Course, etc.)

weekend events

○ Safely supervise all activities according to ETC operating policies, protocols, and

procedures

○ Manage stipends\-tracking attendance and payments

○ Provide support with Regatta, ETC gala and inclusion training as needed.

○ Support YLP PM with outreach for potential summer participants including attending

tabling events at local high schools and after school programs

○ Plan and execute YLP meet ups for the Alumni community

○ Support with interviewing summer fellow field interns

○ Update YLP manuals and student journals in collaboration with YLP PM

○ Support with maintenance of program vehicles in preparation for summer

○ Support the YLP Program Manager with maintaining camping gear inventory,

ensuring equipment is clean and in good condition throughout the year.
